text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер impresses the spectators
with a
strong performance. She vows to
become even
better before Токай Тэйо
returns.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, I give her a handmade
origami
trophy for successfully making
the race her own.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I also decide that she is ready for the
Arima Kinen
and suggest that she try
running it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To repay her fans for their support, Nice
Nature
agrees with my suggestion and
enters the Arima
Kinen, deciding our
next goal!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
